faq.g1.q: What is Launchly and how does it work?
faq.g1.a: Launchly is an all-in-one No-Code platform for building Telegram chatbots, visual sales funnels, and automated messaging workflows. You design your flow in a drag-and-drop builder without writing any code.
faq.g2.q: Do I need coding skills to build a bot?
faq.g2.a: No, absolutely not! The entire creation process happens in a visual builder. You simply connect blocks (messages, conditions, delays, actions) with arrows.
faq.g3.q: Is there a free trial or plan?
faq.g3.a: Yes! You can start on our Free plan with up to 100 active contacts at no cost and without credit card details required.
faq.n1.q: Message Node: What is it for and how to configure?
faq.n1.a:
Purpose:
Sends text messages, photos, videos, or interactive buttons to the user in Telegram.

How to configure:
1. Click the "Message" node on the Builder canvas.
2. In the right editor sidebar, type your message text.
3. (Optional) Click "+ Add Button", enter button text, and connect its output handle to the next node in your flow.
faq.n2.q: Condition Node: What is it for and how to configure?
faq.n2.a:
Purpose:
Automatically branches subscribers based on tags, custom CRM field values, or user behavior.

How to configure:
1. Open the "Condition" node sidebar panel.
2. Define your condition rules (e.g.: "Tag equals VIP" or "Custom field paid = true").
3. Connect the "Yes" (True) output handle to the main path and "No" (False) to the alternative path.
faq.n3.q: Action Node: What is it for and how to configure?
faq.n3.a:
Purpose:
Executes background CRM profile operations on the subscriber without sending visible chat messages.

How to configure:
1. Select action type: Add Tag, Remove Tag, Set Field Value, or Alert Manager.
2. Specify the tag name or custom field value in the editor.
3. Connect the node into your flow pipeline.
faq.n4.q: AI Assistant Node: What is it for and how to configure?
faq.n4.a:
Purpose:
Generates intelligent, contextual replies to users powered by AI models (ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini).

How to configure:
1. Click the "AI Assistant" node.
2. Type the System Prompt instructions defining the bot persona, guidelines, and business knowledge.
3. Select your AI model and connect the output handle to the next node.
faq.n5.q: API Call Node: What is it for and how to configure?
faq.n5.a:
Purpose:
Sends or fetches data from external CRMs, payment gateways, databases, or Webhooks (Make/Zapier/n8n).

How to configure:
1. Enter the external API endpoint URL.
2. Select the HTTP Method (GET, POST, PUT).
3. Set Headers (e.g. Bearer auth) and JSON body payload with dynamic variable tags.
faq.n6.q: Smart Delay Node: What is it for and how to configure?
faq.n6.a:
Purpose:
Creates timed pauses before the next step to simulate natural conversation pacing or scheduled follow-ups.

How to configure:
1. Select the delay duration (minutes, hours, or days).
2. (Optional) Enable specific delivery windows (e.g., only send during business hours 9:00 AM - 6:00 PM).
faq.n7.q: A/B Randomizer Node: What is it for and how to configure?
faq.n7.a:
Purpose:
A/B testing different message scripts or offers to discover which scenario yields higher conversion.

How to configure:
1. Set the traffic split percentage (e.g., Variation A — 50%, Variation B — 50%).
2. Connect each variation handle to its corresponding target node.
faq.n8.q: Start Automation Node: What is it for and how to configure?
faq.n8.a:
Purpose:
Seamlessly transferring a subscriber into another automation flow or secondary bot.

How to configure:
1. Select the target automation flow from your workspace dropdown.
2. When a subscriber reaches this step, their session automatically hands over to the new flow.
faq.n9.q: Comment Node: What is it for and how to configure?
faq.n9.a:
Purpose:
Visual notes and team instructions directly on the Builder canvas. Invisible to end subscribers.

How to configure:
1. Drag the "Comment" note onto the canvas.
2. Type your team note/instruction and select a sticky note color.
faq.n10.q: End Flow Node: What is it for and how to configure?
faq.n10.a:
Purpose:
Marking the logical completion of a conversational flow.

How to configure:
Connect the "End" node at the terminal point of any flow branch to cleanly finish the session.
faq.b1.q: How do I connect a Telegram bot to Launchly?
faq.b1.a:
1. Create a bot via official @BotFather in Telegram and get an API Token.
2. Navigate to "Bots" section in Launchly.
3. Paste the token — your bot is instantly online!
faq.b2.q: What are Triggers and Actions in the Builder?
faq.b2.a: A Trigger is an event that starts a flow (e.g., user subscription or /start command). An Action is an execution step (updating a tag, setting a CRM custom field, or sending an admin notification).
faq.b3.q: Can I send mass broadcasts to my audience?
faq.b3.a: Yes, in the "Broadcasts" section you can create instant mass campaigns or schedule timed broadcasts with audience filtering by tags and custom fields.
faq.a1.q: How do AI Assistant nodes work?
faq.a1.a: You can add an AI node anywhere in your flow, specify system instructions (Prompt), and choose your model (ChatGPT, Claude, or Gemini). The AI will answer users in the context of your business.
faq.a2.q: Can I train AI with knowledge about my product?
faq.a2.a: Yes, you can provide product descriptions, price lists, FAQs, and sales scripts inside the node prompt to train the AI on your specific business knowledge.
faq.m1.q: Which payment gateways are supported for in-chat checkout?
faq.m1.a: Launchly natively supports Stripe and PayPal integrations. You can sell products or subscriptions directly inside the Telegram chat conversation.
faq.m2.q: How do I upgrade or cancel my subscription?
faq.m2.a: You can upgrade your plan or cancel subscription anytime in your Dashboard under "Settings → Billing".
faq.s1.q: How secure is my data and subscriber information?
faq.s1.a: All data is transmitted via 256-bit SSL encryption. We adhere strictly to GDPR regulations and never share your subscriber databases with third parties.

landing.faq.q2: How long does it take to launch the first automation?
landing.faq.a2: Between 3 and 15 minutes. With a ready-made template it's even faster. Most customers launch their first bot the same day they sign up.

landing.faq.q4: How many Telegram bots can I connect?
landing.faq.a4: Starter plan: 1 bot. Growth plan: up to 5 bots. Pro plan: unlimited bots. Each bot can have its own independent funnel and logic.
landing.faq.q5: Is there an API for custom integrations?

landing.faq.q6: What happens to my bots after the subscription ends?
landing.faq.a6: Bots switch to read-only mode — they pause, but all settings and data are preserved. Once you renew, everything is restored instantly with no reconfiguration needed.
